notes.title: Update 18 v.1.09601
notes.notes:
This update fixes and improves many things according to players feedback.

Now camera is perfectly isometric. Previously it felt like it is top down. Camera changes take effect when you start a new mission or complete your current mission.
Now search lights have a visible zone where light can detect player.
New statistics screen after completing each mission. How many enemies you killed, how many times you saved and loaded the game, How much time you took to complete the mission etc....
Many other fixes and improvements


If you encounter memory leak issues or frequent crashes then locate game folder and run the game without steam or epic games launcher.

notes.title: Update 14
notes.notes:
This is another major update with many fixes and improvements.

Now you can play second playthrough if you already completed the game with different and most difficult enemies placement in same campaign and all 5 characters in each mission. Just open and close last mission to unlock second playthrough.
Now Anti Aliasing method option given in settings. So you can change any method of Anti Aliasing which is available in unreal engine 5. If you don't like blur in trees motion then switch AA to FXAA.
Now you can open or close full map of the whole mission by clicking magnifying glass button at the lower corner of mini-map. Check the example screenshot below.
Fixed if multiple enemies see and gather around dead body on same time sometimes they don't trigger alarm.
Fixed if multiple dead bodies are at same place enemies continue to see same body again and again.
Fixed sometimes dog don't die after eating poisnous meat.
Fixed yellow boxes appear around searchlight while aiming.
Fixed sometimes SPY disguise unweared when walking/running infront of enemies or SPY hiding in bushes.
Fixed berserk gun of SPY sometimes berserked enemy don't kill his teammate despite he is in his sight.
Many other fixes related to dead body detection.
Fixed Sometimes character do not respond to double clicks after tactical pause update.
Major optimization in snow maps because they are biggest maps in the game and volumetric fog causing fps drop at night due to light absorption by fog particles.
Fixed when enemy officer or sniper detect dead body or player their viewcone visually become narrower or shorter like normal enemy.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Increased the zoom out radius for maps to see more area of the map as requested by demo players. Also adjusted Alarm mechanics in the game. In the end of video the game play is on easy difficulty now only 4 to 6 enemies will come at alarm location not all soldiers of the area. In easy difficulty if an enemy see a dead body then he will go to the dead body and then trigger alarm if player kill enemy before reaching to dead body than no alarm will be triggered.... In hard difficulty undistractable guards will trigger the alarm if they see dead body but not in medium and easy
Now in easy difficulty only 4 to 6 enemies will search for the player, others will not come and continue to patrol. In medium 5 to 8 enemies will search In hard 8 to 15 enemies.....but if player use a gun then all enemies in the range of noise circle of gun will come at the location and search for player.
